title: prunus × lannesiana f. shujaku
intro: Prunus × lannesiana f. shujaku, commonly known as Japanese Apricot or Shujaku, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian cultures, to promote overall health and well-being, with benefits including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunus × lannesiana f. shujaku are attributed to its ability to calm the mind and body, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
